dialogues.speaker: Riku
dialogues.text: I'm counting the people coming to the shrine for fortune slips!

dialogues.speaker: Riku
dialogues.text: There was a very short girl in a tanuki outfit drawing a slip, wishing to grow taller or something...

dialogues.speaker: Riku
dialogues.text: There was also a beautiful older girl who wished that Inazuma will remain peaceful and stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Riku
dialogues.text: Oh, and there was some big bro wishing for the Kujou Clan to be prosperous...

dialogues.speaker: Riku
dialogues.text: Their wishes are so special. My wish is just to be able to play Hide-and-Seek with my sister...
